entries.name: INSTANCE_NAME
entries.description: Display name of the business this instance serves.
howToGet: Use the business's public name.

entries.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
entries.description: Permanent id of the business. Every row in the database is tagged with it.
howToGet: Lowercase the business name and replace spaces with dashes. Never change it after the first deploy.

entries.name: ENABLED_INTEGRATIONS
entries.description: Comma-separated integrations this instance uses. Secrets for an integration are only required once it is listed here.
howToGet: Start empty and add each integration as you connect it.

entries.name: INSTANCE_API_KEY
entries.description: Key that agents and connectors send to call this instance's API.
howToGet: Generated automatically by npm run secrets:setup.

entries.name: WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
entries.description: Signs and verifies webhooks this instance sends or receives.
howToGet: Generated automatically by npm run secrets:setup.

entries.name: SUPABASE_URL
entries.description: Address of this client's own Supabase project.
howToGet: Open supabase.com/dashboard and pick this client's project (each client gets its own).
Go to Project Settings > API.
Copy the Project URL.

entries.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
entries.description: Public (anon or publishable) key for the same Supabase project.
howToGet: In the same Supabase project, go to Project Settings > API.
Copy the anon public key (or the publishable key).
It must come from the same project as SUPABASE_URL, or Supabase answers HTTP 401.

entries.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
entries.description: Server-only key that bypasses row-level security. Never put it in a browser or app.
howToGet: In the same Supabase project, go to Project Settings > API and copy the service_role (or secret) key.

entries.name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
entries.description: Direct Postgres connection string. The instance uses it to store data and run migrations.
howToGet: In the same Supabase project, click Connect at the top of the dashboard.
Copy the URI connection string (Session pooler works everywhere).
Replace [YOUR-PASSWORD] with the database password you set when creating the project.

entries.name: DOC_REGISTRY_IDS
entries.description: Comma-separated ids of the source-of-truth docs reasoning must consult. Optional, but without it every recommendation is marked degraded.
howToGet: Leave as is unless you maintain your own documentation registry.

entries.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
entries.description: Lets Brain A use Claude for reasoning.
howToGet: Go to console.anthropic.com > API Keys and create a key named after this instance.

entries.name: SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN
howToGet: In Shopify admin, go to Settings > Domains and copy the myshopify.com domain.

entries.name: SHOPIFY_ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: Admin API token for reading orders, products and customers.
howToGet: In Shopify admin, go to Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps.
Create an app, grant read access to orders, products, customers and inventory, then install it.
Copy the Admin API access token. Shopify shows it only once.

entries.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
entries.description: Restricted Stripe key for reading payments.
howToGet: In the Stripe dashboard, go to Developers > API keys and create a restricted key with read-only access.

entries.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.description: Verifies that webhooks really came from Stripe.
howToGet: In Stripe, go to Developers > Webhooks, add this instance's webhook URL, and copy its signing secret.

entries.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: HubSpot private app token for contacts and deals.
howToGet: In HubSpot, go to Settings > Integrations > Private Apps, create an app with CRM read scopes, and copy its token.

entries.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
entries.description: Lets Brain A post alerts and recommendations to Slack.
howToGet: At api.slack.com/apps, create an app, add the chat:write scope, install it, and copy the Bot User OAuth Token.

entries.name: MONDAY_API_TOKEN
entries.description: Monday.com API token for boards and items.
howToGet: In Monday.com, click your avatar > Developers > My access tokens, and copy the token.
